# Technology, Magic & Items

## Abraham Lincoln {#abraham-lincoln}

The Abraham Lincoln is a fast, high-pressure steam frigate equipped with a variety of weaponry and tasked with the mission of hunting a mysterious, gigantic marine creature.

**Used by:** [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md)

## Astrolabe {#astrolabe}

The Astrolabe was a corvette commanded by Dumont d'Urville that participated in a voyage of circumnavigation alongside the Boussole before both vessels were wrecked on the reefs of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro).

## Bunsen {#bunsen}

The Bunsen pile is a component of the [Ruhmkorff](../codex/tech.md#ruhmkorff) apparatus that utilizes sodium to generate electricity for underwater illumination.

## Helvetia {#helvetia}

The Helvetia is a vessel of the Compagnie-Nationale that, along with the [Shannon](../codex/tech.md#shannon), observed a mysterious, enormous aquatic creature in the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

## Moravian {#moravian}

The Moravian is a vessel belonging to the Montreal Ocean Company that sustained damage to its keel after striking an uncharted object in the sea on March 5, 1867.

## Nautilus {#nautilus}

The Nautilus is a steel, spindle-shaped submarine vessel, devoid of masts or rigging, that is capable of navigating the depths of the ocean at great speeds and defying the most violent surface tempests.

**Used by:** [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md)

## Recherche {#recherche}

The Recherche refers to both a large merchantman vessel commissioned by the French government in 1791 to search for the lost expedition of [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md), and a later vessel placed at the disposal of Captain [Dillon](../character/dillon.md) in 1827 that successfully recovered relics from the site of the wreck at [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro).

## Rouquayrol {#rouquayrol}

The Rouquayrol apparatus is a portable diving system consisting of an iron reservoir that stores air under high pressure, allowing a diver to breathe independently while submerged for several hours.

## Ruhmkorff {#ruhmkorff}

The Ruhmkorff apparatus is a portable lighting device consisting of a sodium-powered [Bunsen](../codex/tech.md#bunsen) pile and a lantern containing a spiral glass filled with carbonic gas that produces a continuous white light for underwater exploration.

## Scotia {#scotia}

The Scotia is a steamship of the Cunard Company line that sustained a large, triangular perforation in its hull after being struck by an unknown, powerful object while at sea.

## Shannon {#shannon}

The Shannon is a vessel belonging to the Royal Mail Steamship Company that, while sailing in the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), encountered an enormous, rapid, and mysterious aquatic creature.
